name: Dark Warrior
author: Hendrik Berends
description:
Few walk away from the Shadowlord's blessings. Most come apart under them and are last seen dragging themselves back towards the Pit. She kept her shape, kept the horns and the fused plate, and hires out her maul to anyone in the ruins who can meet her price.

MERCENARIES may only hire her if their warband includes no Elf Ranger, Troll Slayer or Warrior Priest, and no Holy Relic.

abilities.name: Chaos Armour
abilities.text: The Defense characteristic of this fighter can never be reduced.

abilities.name: Heart of the Warrior
abilities.text: This fighter automatically passes any Bravery test.

abilities.name: Sweeping Blow
abilities.text: When an enemy fighter is taken out of action by a melee attack action made by this fighter with a two handed weapon, this fighter makes a free melee attack action targeting another enemy fighter within 1".
